messages.content: I just moved to Utrecht and I am renting a small flat near the canal.
Congratulations on the move. How are you settling in?
Well enough. I planted tomatoes, basil and chives on the balcony.
Update: I moved again, and now I live in Rotterdam, close to the harbour.
Rotterdam is lively. Is the balcony garden coming along?
Yes, the tomatoes are ripe. Next week I will visit my sister in Leiden.
This weekend I cycled sixty kilometres along the river Maas.
That is a long ride. Did you pack enough food?
I brought three things: bananas, rye bread and a thermos of coffee.
My bicycle has a cracked rear rim, so the repair shop keeps it until Friday.
Thank you for letting me know, I will remember that.
Noor: I signed up for the pottery class on Thursday evenings.
Tomasz: I prefer the Saturday kiln session, and I make blue glazed bowls.
Noor: Then we only meet at the exhibition in July.
Tomasz: The exhibition opened yesterday and my bowls sold out.
Noor: Wonderful, I shall bring a green vase next time.
Ich habe heute einen neuen Kaffeeladen in der Altstadt entdeckt, er heisst Morgenrot.
Das klingt gut. Was hast du dort getrunken?
Einen Cortado, und ich habe Hafermilch gewaehlt.
